description:
Build Astro components for the header (Docs, Blog, Results, GitHub, search, theme toggle), the footer, the docs layout (sidebar, breadcrumbs, on-page TOC, edit link) and the blog layout.

The header must match the current header contract: results-explorer/src headerContract.ts and tests/unit/test_site_header_parity.py. Explorer and site then render the same header.

The sidebar is generated from a config that the converter (astro-site-31) derives from the toctrees.

Pagefind indexes docs and blog. Results pages may be indexed by title only.

Use real <a>/<button> elements, keep 44px touch targets, and make the layout work at phone width.
